simple.errorUnchanged: Your DNS is unchanged, nothing was modified

servers.title: SERVERS
servers.name: name
servers.addHint: Paste URLs (https://, tls://, quic://) or sdns:// stamps, one server per line.

dpi.title: DPI BYPASS
dpi.waiting: On — GoodbyeDPI starts when you connect
dpi.webFragmentNote: Web fragmentation (Proxy page) only applies to apps that use the proxy; GoodbyeDPI applies to every app.

logs.title: LOGS
logs.queriesNote: kept in RAM only, at most 500 lines, never written to disk

log.DEGRADED: servers not responding, finding new ones

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.stopServiceConfirm: The Windows service {{name}} holds port 53. Stopping it can break Mobile Hotspot, WSL or Hyper-V until you restart. Continue?

NOT_ADMIN.message: Ghostline needs administrator rights to change DNS

PORT53_BUSY.action: Close that program or stop the service in Settings

NO_SERVERS.message: no working servers found ({{checked}} tried in {{elapsed}}s)

ENGINE_SELFTEST_FAILED.message: the local DNS engine failed to start
ENGINE_SELFTEST_FAILED.action: Retry; check the logs if it repeats

VERIFY_LEAK.message: DNS queries are not going through Ghostline (a VPN or another tool owns DNS)
VERIFY_LEAK.action: Turn off the VPN/other DNS tool and retry

RESTORE_FAILED.message: could not restore the original DNS on {{adapter}}

DPI_BLOCKED_BY_AV.action: Exclude the Ghostline folder in your antivirus (WinDivert is often flagged falsely)

DPI_HASH_MISMATCH.message: GoodbyeDPI files were modified; Ghostline refuses to run them

SERVERLIST_BAD_SIGNATURE.message: the downloaded server list had a bad signature and was ignored

AUTOTUNE_NO_PRESET.message: no working DPI bypass configuration found
AUTOTUNE_NO_PRESET.action: Try Mode 1–6 or custom arguments in Advanced mode

SETTINGS_RESET.message: the settings file was corrupt, defaults are in use

STATE_RESET.message: the state file was corrupt; adapters still pointing at Ghostline were reset to DHCP
STATE_RESET.action: Re-check adapter DNS if you used static DNS before

NOT_CONNECTED.message: connect first to auto-tune DPI bypass

PROXY_PORT_BUSY.action: Change the proxy port or close that program

PROXY_SELFTEST_FAILED.message: the proxy failed its self test
PROXY_SELFTEST_FAILED.action: Retry; check the logs if it repeats

PROXY_FIREWALL.message: could not create the firewall rule for LAN sharing
PROXY_FIREWALL.action: Retry or turn LAN sharing off

SYSPROXY_EXISTING.message: this PC already uses another proxy ({{server}}{{pac}}). Replace it? Ghostline puts it back when disconnecting.

SYSPROXY_FAILED.message: could not set the Windows system proxy
SYSPROXY_FAILED.action: Retry or turn off "use for this PC"

SYSPROXY_TAKEN_OVER.message: another app changed the system proxy; Ghostline will not fight it or restore over it

SYSPROXY_RESTORE_FAILED.message: could not restore the Windows system proxy
SYSPROXY_RESTORE_FAILED.action: Open Windows Settings → Proxy and turn the manual proxy off

LIST_FETCH_FAILED.message: could not download list {{id}}; the previous copy is in use

LIST_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.message: list {{id}} is in an unsupported format
LIST_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.action: Pick the format manually or use the text version

LIST_TOO_LARGE.message: list {{id}} is too large (50 MB / 2 million entries max) and was turned off

UPSTREAM_PROXY_FAILED.action: Check the address or re-enter the password

proxy.title: PROXY
proxy.note: the proxy runs with Connect and always resolves names through Ghostline's encrypted DNS

lan.title: share with other devices
lan.public: This network is Public, so other devices cannot connect. Switch it to Private in Windows Settings to share.
lan.howto: On a phone: Wi-Fi → this network → Proxy → Manual → enter the address and port above (HTTP).

hint.goodbyedpi: {{count}} connections were blocked even fragmented — try GoodbyeDPI on the DPI page

rules.title: RULES
rules.syntax: syntax: <pattern> <action…> · patterns: domain, =domain, *.domain, ~keyword, /regexp/, CIDR · actions: block, allow, ip=, fragment=auto|on|off, upstream=<id> · # comment · #! disabled rule

explain.title: test a domain
explain.none: no rule or list matches — goes direct

lists.title: lists
lists.formats: supported: hosts, domains, AdBlock/AdGuard, dnsmasq, Unbound, RPZ, Clash/Surge, v2ray, sing-box (JSON), CIDR · GitHub links are turned into raw links

items.hagezi-light: Basic protection: ads, trackers, metrics, telemetry. Small and safe.
items.hagezi-normal: All-round protection against ads, tracking and badware.
items.hagezi-pro: Extended protection: also phishing, malware, scams. Recommended by its author.
items.hagezi-pro-plus: Maximum protection; may block a few legitimate sites.
items.hagezi-ultimate: Aggressive protection; expect occasional false positives.
items.stevenblack-unified: Classic unified hosts file: adware and malware.
items.hagezi-tif-mini: Malware, phishing, scam and cryptojacking domains (compact).
items.hagezi-fake: Fake shops, scams and rip-off sites.
items.stevenblack-social: Social networks (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X…), e.g. for parental control.
items.hagezi-windows: Windows and Office tracking and telemetry.
items.hostsvn: Ads and trackers common on Vietnamese sites.
items.v2fly-telegram: Telegram domains: fragment through the proxy.
items.v2fly-discord: Discord domains: fragment through the proxy.
items.v2fly-twitter: X (Twitter) domains: fragment through the proxy.
items.v2fly-facebook: Facebook domains: fragment through the proxy.
items.v2fly-youtube: YouTube domains: fragment through the proxy.
items.v2fly-reddit: Reddit domains: fragment through the proxy.
